/* Section Background */
.why-choose-us {
  background: #f4f4f4;
  padding: 50px 0;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
}

/* Main Circle Container */
.circle-container {
  position: relative;
  width: 700px;
  height:600px;
}

/* Center Circle */
.center-circle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 30%;
  left: 50%;
  width: 400px;
  height: 400px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  background: #e9ecef;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 10px solid #000000;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.center-circle h2 {
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #000000;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* Items Common Style */
.item {
  position: absolute;
  text-align: center;
  width: 140px;
}

.item p {
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #333;
}

/* Icon Circle */
.icon {
  width: 70px;
  height: 70px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  margin: auto;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 26px;
